title: Pad sealed plaintext
responsibility: Pad plaintext to size buckets before sealing and strictly remove that padding after opening, so the server sees only bucketed sizes.

inputs.name: sealedBucket.length
inputs.description: Plaintext byte count before adding the length prefix.

inputs.name: sealedPadding.bytes
inputs.description: Plaintext bytes to encode with a length prefix and zero padding.

inputs.name: sealedUnpadding.padded
inputs.description: Decrypted bytes containing a length prefix and trailing padding.

outputs.name: sealedBucket
outputs.description: Smallest supported padded size that can hold the length prefix and plaintext.

outputs.name: sealedPadding
outputs.description: Bucket-sized buffer containing the length prefix, plaintext, and zero padding.

outputs.name: sealedUnpadding
outputs.description: Copy of the original plaintext bytes.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The length prefix is missing or out of range, or the trailing padding contains nonzero bytes.
